cause: The native boundary permanently refused the first RESOURCE_WATCH_UNSAFE CPU event even though the guard required two consecutive bad watches to stop. A child that exited before confirmation finalized child_failed instead of resource-invalid.

contract.first_cpu_only_bad: The guard writes RESOURCE_CPU_PENDING with the measured sample and reasons. Every native action boundary blocks while that episode remains pending; the one-heavy permit stays owned.
contract.recovery: The guard writes one atomic RESOURCE_CPU_RECOVERED health event after three consecutive fully healthy watches. A later fresh boundary check may then allow a new action. Earlier unsafe history is never cleared.
contract.confirmation: Two consecutive CPU-bad watches write irreversible RESOURCE_WATCH_UNSAFE, hold and stop markers, and an invalid terminal verdict. Any non-CPU failure takes this immediate unsafe path.
contract.bound: The guard uses a monotonic episode deadline of (unsafeSamplesToStop + healthySamplesToResume) * watchIntervalSeconds; the boundary also has a monotonic wait bound derived from these knobs. Expiry and unresolved child or operator exit are invalid.
contract.unchanged: No numeric threshold, preflight admission rule, one-heavy cap, owner census, journal publication, or cleanup path changed. No prior journal gains retroactive validity.

verification.mutation_pending_refusal: plant.py replaced the pending refusal with a false branch; real journal-to-boundary test went RED because an action could start during pending. Mutation was restored byte-identically.
verification.mutation_terminal_verdict: plant.py removed cpuPending from resourceVerdict; the terminal regression went RED (valid instead of invalid). Mutation was restored byte-identically.
verification.format: Biome check on owned source and tests passed with four pre-existing style warnings in stabilization-resource.mjs.
verification.scope_limit: No native/browser launch, full build, workflow, release, or physical CPU recovery claim. Independent source review and a single guarded native confirmation remain with root.
